title: THE NATURE OF ADDICTION
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.answer: x — Not all addictions are cause for concern
questions.answerKey: x — Not all addictions are cause for concern
questions.translation: 並非所有 addiction 都值得嚴重擔憂目標段落：Paragraph B

blocks.text: “To try to define the subject of addiction (and in many cases the subsequent course of treatment to best combat it), psychologists now commonly refer to three distinct categories.”
為了嘗試定義 addiction 這個主題，並在很多情況下決定之後最合適的治療方向，心理學家現在通常會參考三個不同類別。

“This category is referred to as soft addiction and is generally related only to a potential loss of productivity; in the workplace, an employee who is addicted to social networking sites is likely to be a less useful member of staff.”
這一類稱為 soft addiction，通常只與潛在的生產力下降有關；在工作場所，一名沉迷社交網站的員工很可能會成為較沒效率的員工。
只看首尾句，可以先猜 Paragraph B 正在介紹 addiction 的第一個分類，而且這個分類的風險相對較低。最後一句的 “only” 很重要，因為它限制了問題範圍：一般只涉及 productivity，不直接等同嚴重健康或生命危險。
“only to a potential loss of productivity”
這些字眼共同把段落導向「某些 addiction 比較輕微」的意思。
“The first category concerns forms of addiction that are perhaps not life-threatening or particularly dangerous.”
第一類涉及一些 addiction 形式，它們或許不會危及生命，也未必特別危險。
“They are often labelled in an almost tongue-in-cheek manner, such as excessive chocolate consumption leading to someone being labelled a ‘chocoholic’.”
它們常以近乎半開玩笑的方式被標籤，例如過量吃朱古力的人被稱為 “chocoholic”。
“tongue-in-cheek” 帶有輕鬆、半玩笑語氣，說明這類 addiction 不一定要用非常嚴重的方式看待。再加上段末 “only to a potential loss of productivity”，heading x 可以覆蓋整段。
heading：“Not all addictions are cause for concern”
“only to a potential loss of productivity”
改寫關係： not cause for concern = not life-threatening / not particularly dangerous not all addictions = first category / soft addiction

viii “The lack of clarity in modern interpretations of addiction” 很容易吸引人，因為 Paragraph B也在 define addiction。不過這個 heading 已用於 Paragraph A，而且 B 的重點轉到 soft addiction的低危程度。判斷 heading 時，段末 “only” 和 “soft addiction” 更能控制答案。

questions.answer: iii — Biological changes and associated risks
questions.answerKey: iii — Biological changes and associated risks
questions.translation: 生物變化和相關風險目標段落：Paragraph C

blocks.text: “Substance addiction, however, is a completely different category that focuses on the ingestion of a drug (either natural or synthetic) to alter the brain’s chemical constitution temporarily.”
Substance addiction 則是完全不同的一類，焦點在於攝入某種藥物，不論是天然或合成，以暫時改變大腦的化學構成。
“Users who are addicted will often go to great lengths to acquire these substances, which helps explain the very strong connection between drug abuse and crime.”
成癮者常會不惜代價取得這些物質，這有助解釋濫用藥物和犯罪之間非常強的關聯。
首句顯示這段處理生物或化學層面：drug ingestion alters brain chemistry。末句則把 substance addiction 連到 crime。首尾句合起來看，這段同時有 biological changes 和 associated risks。
“It is a combination of physical and psychological dependence on substances that have known health dangers.”
它是對某些已知有健康危害的物質產生身體和心理依賴的組合。
這句把 substance addiction 的兩層風險講清楚：一方面涉及身體和心理依賴，另一方面涉及已知健康危險。再加上首句的 brain’s chemical constitution，heading iii 中的 biological changes 有直接支撐。
iv “The long-term damage of addiction” 看似相關，因為 Paragraph C 有 health dangers。可是這段沒有集中談 long-term damage，反而以 ingestion、brain chemistry、dependence、crime risk 構成主線。iii 更能覆蓋整段。

questions.answer: ix — Modern label for taking addiction to extremes
questions.answerKey: ix — Modern label for taking addiction to extremes
questions.translation: 把 addiction 推向極端時使用的現代標籤目標段落：Paragraph D

blocks.text: “Finally, there is behavioural addiction, which is regarded as ‘a compulsion to engage in some specific activity, despite harmful consequences’ and is a relatively recent entrant to the field.”
最後，還有 behavioural addiction，它被視為「即使有有害後果，仍強迫性地參與某項特定活動」，也是這個領域中相對較新的概念。

“Also included in this category are behaviours such as excessive gambling, and, for many, the combination of the availability and anonymity of the internet, as well as a plethora of online gambling sites, has led to a vast increase in this form of addiction.”
這一類也包括 excessive gambling 等行為；對很多人來說，互聯網的可用性和匿名性，再加上大量 online gambling sites，已令這種 addiction 大幅增加。
首句直接定義 behavioural addiction，並說它是 relatively recent entrant。段中又說 soft addictions 超過 safe limit 後可變危險。因此 heading ix 的 “modern label” 和 “taking addiction to extremes” 都能在這段找到支撐。
“soft addictions go beyond a safe limit”
“This is where ‘soft’ addictions go beyond a safe limit and can become dangerous.”
這就是 soft addictions 超過安全界線並可能變得危險的地方。
這句是 heading ix 的核心。Paragraph B 的 soft addiction 本身較輕微；到了 Paragraph D，當它超越 safe limit，便進入 behavioural addiction 的範圍。這正好是 “taking addiction to extremes” 的意思。
“a relatively recent entrant to the field”
“go beyond a safe limit and can become dangerous”
iii 也有 risks，因為 Paragraph D 提到 obesity 和 health risks。可是 iii 更貼合 Paragraph C 的brain chemistry 和 substance dependence。Paragraph D 的獨特功能是介紹 behavioural addiction 這個新分類，以及 soft addiction 超過界線後的危險狀態。

questions.translation: 關於定義的分歧目標段落：Paragraph E

blocks.text: “However, the point at which a soft addiction becomes a behavioural addiction is both hard to define and a cause of significant controversy.”
可是，soft addiction 在哪一點變成 behavioural addiction，既難以定義，也引起重大爭議。

“Another point of friction among people involved in studying and treating sufferers is that some of the issues covered by the umbrella term ‘addiction’ may be mislabelled: they belong to a different category altogether and should be referred to as ‘impulse-control disorders’.”
研究和治療患者的人之間另一個摩擦點是，某些被 umbrella term “addiction” 涵蓋的問題可能被錯誤標籤；它們屬於完全不同的類別，應稱為 “impulse-control disorders”。
首尾句幾乎直接指向 heading v。第一句有 hard to define 和 controversy；最後一句有 point of friction 和 mislabelled。整段就是在講定義界線和分類名稱的爭議。

“A child who comes home after school and plays on the internet for three hours is considered by some to be suffering from a behavioural addiction; to others, this is just a modern form of leisure time and just as valid as reading a book or playing outside.”
一個孩子放學後回家上網玩三小時，有些人會認為他患有 behavioural addiction；對另一些人來說，這只是現代休閒形式，和看書或到外面玩同樣合理。
這個例子展示同一行為被不同人解讀成兩種性質：有人當作 addiction，有人當作 leisure。這正是disagreement about definition 的具體表現。
vii “The changing nature of addiction in children” 有吸引力，因為段中有 child 的例子。可是孩子上網只是例子，用來說明定義爭議。段落首尾句都回到 define / controversy / mislabelled，所以 v更能覆蓋全段。

questions.translation: 方法上的改變目標段落：Paragraph F

blocks.text: “The correct course of action when attempting to overcome an addiction varies greatly according to the type of addiction, while opinions within the medical community also differ considerably.”
嘗試克服 addiction 時，正確處理方法會因 addiction 類型而大幅不同，醫學界內部的意見也有很大差異。

“Often, extreme addictions—both substance-based and behavioural—stem from psychological roots such as stress, guilt, depression and rejection; for this reason, counselling and open discussion are producing more successful long-term results.”
極端 addiction，不論是 substance-based 或 behavioural，常常源於 stress、guilt、depression、rejection 等 psychological roots；因此，counselling 和 open discussion 正帶來更成功的長期結果。
首句說治療方法因類型不同，意見也不同；末句說現時較成功的長期方法是 counselling and open discussion。這段自然會處理 treatment approach 的轉變。
“no longer considered the best long-term approach”
“The traditional approach has been to remove the source—that is, the availability of the drug—but this is no longer considered the best long-term approach.”
傳統方法是移除來源，也就是藥物的可取得性；可是這現已不再被視為最佳長期方法。
“There is now an increasing tendency to consider not only the physical mechanisms of addiction but also its psychological causes.”
現在越來越傾向同時考慮 addiction 的身體機制和心理原因。
這兩句構成方法轉變：從單純 remove source / isolate the addict，轉向處理 psychological causes。段末的 counselling and open discussion 是新方法的具體結果。
iii 或 iv 可能因為 substance addiction、relapses、extreme addictions 出現而吸引學生。可是這段的控制詞是 “course of action”、“traditional approach”、“no longer”、“increasing tendency”，全都指向 treatment methods 的轉變。

questions.translation: 給相關人士的建議目標段落：Paragraph G

blocks.text: “For non-professionals who have people in their lives suffering from some form of addiction, the focus now should be on supporting their recovery, not enabling their dependence.”
對於生活中有 addiction sufferer 的非專業人士來說，現在的焦點應放在支持他們康復，而不應助長他們的依賴。
“Judgemental attitudes or helping to conceal addiction have been shown not only to perpetuate the problem, but in many cases actually exacerbate it.”
批判態度或幫忙掩飾 addiction 已被證明會延續問題，在很多情況下甚至會令問題惡化。
首句直接指向 non-professionals who have people in their lives suffering from addiction，也就是身邊有成癮者的人。段落語氣是 should be on supporting recovery，明顯是 advice。
“the focus now should be on supporting their recovery, not enabling their dependence.”
現在的焦點應放在支持他們康復，而不應助長他們的依賴。
這句的 should 是建議訊號。原文對 non-professionals 說明應該做甚麼，也說明甚麼做法會使情況更糟。這正好符合 “Advice for those involved”。
“non-professionals who have people in their lives suffering from some form of addiction”
iv “The long-term damage of addiction” 可能因為 “perpetuate” 和 “exacerbate” 看似有關。但Paragraph G 的焦點不在描述 addiction 本身造成的 long-term damage；它是在給身邊人士處理addiction 的建議。

questions.prompt: “It is increasingly difficult to differentiate between an addiction and what?”
questions.translation: 現在越來越難分辨 addiction 和甚麼之間的差異？

blocks.text: 這題問 what，所以答案需要一個名詞或名詞短語。題目中的 “differentiate between” 通常會對應原文的 “lines between X and Y are hard to identify”。
“Many people would perhaps, at least as an immediate response, not consider themselves to be ‘addicts’, yet a closer look at lifestyle and mental attitude often reveals a very different picture.”
很多人第一反應大概不會把自己看成 “addicts”，可是更仔細看生活方式和心理態度，常會看到很不同的情況。
“Gambling, food, work and shopping are all potential areas in which addiction can lurk.”
賭博、食物、工作和購物，全都是 addiction 可能潛藏的領域。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段在說 addiction 的現代範圍擴大，所以題目中 “increasingly difficult” 很可能來自這段。
“the lines between addiction and interest are far harder to identify”
“The main problem at present is that the traditional definition of the word has become blurred and the lines between addiction and interest are far harder to identify.”
目前主要問題是，這個詞的傳統定義已變得模糊，addiction 和 interest 之間的界線也更難辨認。
題目把 “differentiate between” 改寫自 “the lines between… are far harder to identify”。空格問addiction 和甚麼難分辨，原文答案是 interest。
differentiate between = identify the lines between increasingly difficult = far harder addiction and what = addiction and interest答案形式interest = 1 word，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

questions.prompt: “What can soft addictions lead to a decline in?”
questions.translation: soft addictions 會導致甚麼下降？

blocks.text: 問題問 “a decline in”，所以要找 loss / decrease / lower 之類的詞。答案應是被下降的對象。
“To try to define the subject of addiction (and in many cases the subsequent course of treatment to best combat it), psychologists now commonly refer to three distinct categories.”
為了定義 addiction，並在很多情況下決定之後最合適的治療方向，心理學家現在通常會參考三個不同類別。

“This category is referred to as soft addiction and is generally related only to a potential loss of productivity; in the workplace, an employee who is addicted to social networking sites is likely to be a less useful member of staff.”
這一類稱為 soft addiction，通常只與潛在的生產力下降有關；在工作場所，沉迷社交網站的員工很可能會成為較沒效率的員工。
段落最後一句直接有 soft addiction 和 loss of productivity，所以定位非常穩。
題目問 “lead to a decline in what?” 原文的 “loss of” 就是 decline in。答案需要名詞，填productivity。
decline in = loss of soft addictions = soft addiction what declines = productivity答案形式productivity = 1 word，符合字數限制。
有人可能想填 “staff” 或 “useful member”，因為句末提到 less useful member of staff。可是這只是 workplace 例子，用來說明 productivity loss。題目問下降的對象，答案是 productivity。

questions.prompt: “What are addictions involving the consumption of a drug clearly connected with?”
questions.translation: 涉及攝入藥物的 addictions 和甚麼有明顯關聯？

blocks.text: 題目中的 “consumption of a drug” 對應 Paragraph C 的 ingestion of a drug。問題問 clearly connected with，所以要找 connection with what。
“Substance addiction, however, is a completely different category that focuses on the ingestion of a drug (either natural or synthetic) to alter the brain’s chemical constitution temporarily.”
Substance addiction 是完全不同的一類，焦點在攝入某種藥物，不論天然或合成，以暫時改變大腦化學構成。
“Users who are addicted will often go to great lengths to acquire these substances, which helps explain the very strong connection between drug abuse and crime.”
成癮者常會不惜代價取得這些物質，這有助解釋 drug abuse 和 crime 之間非常強的關聯。
首尾句已經把題目完整包住：consumption of a drug = ingestion of a drug；connected with =connection between drug abuse and crime。
“Users who are addicted will often go to great lengths to acquire these substances, which helps explain the very strong connection between drug abuse and crime.”
成癮者常會不惜代價取得這些物質，這有助解釋濫用藥物和犯罪之間非常強的關聯。
這句的核心是 “very strong connection”。題目用 “clearly connected with” 改寫這個意思。被連接的對象是 crime。

addictions involving the consumption of a drug = substance addiction / ingestion of a drug clearly connected with = very strong connection between answer = crime答案形式crime = 1 word，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

questions.prompt: “What specific addiction has increased considerably over recent years?”
questions.translation: 近年哪一種具體 addiction 大幅增加？

blocks.text: 這題問 specific addiction，所以要找某個具體例子。題目中的 “increased considerably” 應對應原文 “vast increase”。
“Finally, there is behavioural addiction, which is regarded as ‘a compulsion to engage in some specific activity, despite harmful consequences’ and is a relatively recent entrant to the field.”
最後，還有 behavioural addiction，它被視為「即使有有害後果，仍強迫性地參與某項特定活動」，也是這個領域中相對較新的概念。

“Also included in this category are behaviours such as excessive gambling, and, for many, the combination of the availability and anonymity of the internet, as well as a plethora of online gambling sites, has led to a vast increase in this form of addiction.”
這一類也包括 excessive gambling 等行為；對很多人來說，互聯網的可用性和匿名性，以及大量online gambling sites，已令這種 addiction 大幅增加。
最後一句直接出現 “vast increase”，所以答案在這句。
“Also included in this category are behaviours such as excessive gambling…”
這一類也包括 excessive gambling 等行為。
“…has led to a vast increase in this form of addiction.”
……已導致這種 addiction 大幅增加。
“this form of addiction” 回指前面提到的 excessive gambling。互聯網和 online gambling sites 是造成增長的背景；題目問具體 addiction 名稱，所以答案填 excessive gambling 最完整。

increased considerably = a vast increase specific addiction = excessive gambling over recent years = relatively recent context / internet availability and online sites答案形式excessive gambling = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。
“online gambling sites” 很吸引，因為它在同一句出現。可是 online gambling sites 是造成excessive gambling 增加的條件之一。題目問 addiction itself，較穩答案是 excessive gambling。

questions.prompt: “In some cases, addictions should actually be labelled as what?”
questions.translation: 在某些情況下，addictions 其實應該被標籤為甚麼？

blocks.text: 題目問 labelled as what，答案應是某個分類名稱。定位詞是 labelled / mislabelled。
“However, the point at which a soft addiction becomes a behavioural addiction is both hard to define and a cause of significant controversy.”
可是，soft addiction 在哪一點變成 behavioural addiction，既難以定義，也引起重大爭議。

“Another point of friction among people involved in studying and treating sufferers is that some of the issues covered by the umbrella term ‘addiction’ may be mislabelled: they belong to a different category altogether and should be referred to as ‘impulse-control disorders’.”
研究和治療患者的人之間另一個摩擦點是，某些被 umbrella term “addiction” 涵蓋的問題可能被錯誤標籤；它們屬於完全不同的類別，應稱為 “impulse-control disorders”。
段末直接有 should be referred to as，完全對應 labelled as what。
題目中的 “should actually be labelled as” 改寫了原文 “should be referred to as”。答案必須保留原文專門名稱。

labelled as = referred to as in some cases = some of the issues covered by the umbrella term “addiction” answer = impulse-control disorders答案形式impulse-control disorders = 2 words if hyphenated compound is counted as one unit plus disorders；IELTS 通常接受，且符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

questions.prompt: “Extreme addictions often have what kind of root cause?”
questions.translation: 極端 addictions 常有哪一類根源？

blocks.text: 題目問 “what kind of root cause”，所以要找 root / cause / stem from 一類字。答案需要保留原文詞形。
“The correct course of action when attempting to overcome an addiction varies greatly according to the type of addiction, while opinions within the medical community also differ considerably.”
嘗試克服 addiction 時，正確處理方法會因 addiction 類型而大幅不同，醫學界內部意見也有很大差異。

“Often, extreme addictions—both substance-based and behavioural—stem from psychological roots such as stress, guilt, depression and rejection; for this reason, counselling and open discussion are producing more successful long-term results.”
極端 addiction，不論是 substance-based 或 behavioural，常常源於 stress、guilt、depression、rejection 等 psychological roots；因此，counselling 和 open discussion 正帶來更成功的長期結果。
最後一句直接包含 extreme addictions、stem from、psychological roots，因此答案很穩定。
“Often, extreme addictions—both substance-based and behavioural—stem from psychological roots such as stress, guilt, depression and rejection…”
極端 addiction，不論是 substance-based 或 behavioural，常常源於 stress、guilt、depression、rejection 等心理根源。
“stem from” 表示源於、來自；“psychological roots” 就是題目要找的 kind of root cause。後面的stress、guilt、depression、rejection 是 psychological roots 的例子。
have what kind of root cause = stem from what roots extreme addictions = extreme addictions answer = psychological roots答案形式psychological roots = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：先用首尾句建立全文地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 只看第一句，讀者會先知道很多人第一反應都不會把自己看成 “addicts”。最後一句則說gambling、food、work、shopping 都可能藏有 addiction。首尾句合起來看，這段主要說明現代addiction 的界線變得模糊：過去多指 drugs、alcohol、nicotine 等有害物質，現在範圍擴大到生活習慣和行為。例題 Paragraph A 配 viii 很合理，因為焦點是 modern interpretations lack clarity。

第一句說，psychologists 現在常把 addiction 分成三個 distinct categories，以便定義問題和安排治療。最後一句說，沉迷 social networking sites 的員工可能會變成較沒效率的 staff member。首尾句顯示這段介紹第一類 addiction：soft addiction。它通常不會危及生命，也不算特別危險，問題主要在 productivity loss。這段重點是：有些 addiction 標籤語氣較輕，未必需要用嚴重病理角度看待。

第一句用 however 轉入另一類：substance addiction，是完全不同的 category，焦點在攝入natural 或 synthetic drug，以短暫改變大腦化學構成。最後一句說，這也解釋了 drug abuse 和crime 的強烈關聯。首尾句顯示，這段聚焦於物質成癮的生物層面和相關風險：brain chemistry、physical and psychological dependence、known health dangers、crime。這段很適合用於heading iii 和短答題 Q9。

第一句介紹第三類 behavioural addiction，定義為明知有 harmful consequences 仍compulsively engage in a specific activity。最後一句說，internet 的 availability、anonymity 和大量 online gambling sites 令這類 addiction 大幅增加。首尾句顯示這段說明 behavioural addiction這個較新的分類，以及 soft addictions 超過安全界線後如何變得危險。中間例子包括 overeating、obesity risks 和 excessive gambling。

第一句說，soft addiction 在甚麼點變成 behavioural addiction，很難定義，也是 significant controversy 的來源。最後一句說，有些 umbrella term “addiction” 下的問題可能被 mislabelled，應歸入 impulse-control disorders。首尾句顯示這段焦點是定義爭議：三小時上網可被某些人視為behavioural addiction，也可被另一些人視為現代休閒。這段會支援 heading v 和 Q11。

第一句說，要克服 addiction，正確處理方法會按 addiction type 大幅變化，medical community內部意見也相當不同。最後一句說，counselling and open discussion 正帶來較成功的 long-term results。首尾句顯示這段處理治療方法轉變：過去常用 remove the source / isolate the addict，但這種方法不能防止 relapse；現在更重視 physical mechanisms 加上 psychological causes。這段對應 heading i。

第一句說，對身邊有 addiction sufferer 的非專業人士來說，焦點應放在 supporting their recovery，而非 enabling their dependence。最後一句說，judgemental attitudes 或幫忙 conceal addiction 會 perpetuate，甚至 exacerbate 問題。首尾句顯示這段是 practical advice：親友不應用批判、包庇或掩飾的方式處理 addiction，較合適的方向是支持康復，同時避免加深依賴。 Answer Key 1. x 2. iii 3. ix 4. v 5. i 6. vi 7. interest 8. productivity 9. crime 10. excessive gambling 11. impulse-control disorders 12. psychological roots
